insights.one_liner: Small Amsterdam recruitment agency founded in 2020 that places professionals and offers relocation help for hires from abroad.

culture.text: A recruitment agency founded in 2020, headquartered in Amsterdam, with about 30 people on LinkedIn.
Staff studied at schools like the Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences, VU Amsterdam and Inholland.
Offers search and selection, interim placements and payrolling of candidates.

open.text: Recognised IND sponsor through IQ Staffing B.V.
Offers relocation services to help hires from abroad settle in the Netherlands.
Its one current opening, a senior software role in Utrecht, does not ask for Dutch and drew around 200 LinkedIn applicants.

worth_knowing.text: As a staffing agency, its postings are often for jobs at client companies, possibly on IQ Staffing's own payroll.
